Name: CustomSaveMod
Author: Asakohee
Description:
[b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8c72nsf2/1.png[/img]

[size=2]﻿• Displays custom images on the [u]save screen when the day ends and you go to bed.
[/u]
﻿• Images change based on[u]date[/u], [u]season[/u], and [u]player status[/u] (single, married, or dating).

﻿• Special images appear for normal sleep and [u]late-night sleep[/u](after 2:00am).
[/size]



[size=4][img]https://i.postimg.cc/6p6pYf5g/2.png[/img][/size]
[size=2]
[/size][/b][size=3][b] ﻿[ [/b][b]Folder Structure ][/b][/size]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿[/size]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿• Place images in the following structure : [/size][color=#93c47d][b]assets[/b][/color][color=#93c47d][b]/<season>/<name>_<condition>.png[/b][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][b][size=3]﻿[ Image Naming Rules ][/size][/b]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿[/size]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿• [/size][/color][b]<season> [/b][size=2]: The current season (spring, summer, fall, winter).[/size]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿• [/size][b]<name> [/b][size=2]: farmer, spouse name, or dating partner name.[/size]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿• [/size][b]<condition>[/b][size=2] : [/size]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿- [/size][u]Day-Based[/u][size=2] : Use the day number [/size][color=#93c47d][b](e.g., [/b][/color][b][color=#93c47d]farmer_1.png[/color][/b][color=#93c47d][b] for Day 1).[/b][/color]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿- [/size][u]L[/u][u]ate Sleep[/u][size=2] : Add _tooLate to the file name [/size][color=#93c47d][b](e.g., [/b][/color][b][color=#93c47d]Sam_tooLate.png[/color][/b][color=#93c47d][b]).[/b][/color]

[b][size=3] ﻿[ If No Matching Asset ]
[/size][/b]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿• Searches for the same name in the [/size][b]current season[/b][size=2], then in [/size][b]other seasons[/b][size=2].[/size]
[size=2] ﻿ ﻿• If no assets are found, nothing is displayed, and the game [/size][size=2][u]skips to morning.[/u]

[size=3] [b]﻿[ Config Options ][/b]
[/size]
[size=2] ﻿ [b]﻿• [/b][/size][b]IncludeDatingPartners :[/b] Include dating partners (NPCs with a bouquet).
[size=2] ﻿[b] ﻿﻿• [/b][/size][b]SpouseOnly [/b]: whether only the spouse's images are displayed.
[b] ﻿﻿﻿• [/b]If multiple targets exist, one image is [b]randomly selected[/b].
﻿ ﻿

[/size] [size=2]﻿• This mod [b][color=#93c47d]does not include image assets[/color][/b][color=#93c47d]. 
[/color]
﻿• You must add your own images to the specified folder structure for the mod to function.

﻿• Without image assets, the mod will have [b]no effect[/b][color=#93c47d].[/color][/size][size=3]




[/size][size=3]﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pTswVKth/5.png[/img]

[/size] [size=2][b]Q: Can I use this mod with custom NPCs?[/b]
﻿A: Yes, it supports all marriageable NPCs and any NPCs with defined names.

[b] ﻿Q: What image formats are supported?[/b]
﻿A: Only .png files are supported.

[b] ﻿Q: What about image size and resolution?[/b]
﻿A: The screen resolution is flexible, and images will be centered by default.
﻿    The appearance may vary depending on your monitor resolution, so testing is recommended for your setup.
﻿    The recommended size is [b]1280x720[/b], but the optional asset file has adjusted resolutions and positioning to avoid strict central alignment.

[b] [/b][b]Q: Where can I provide feedback or ask questions about the mod?[/b]
[b] ﻿A:[/b] If you encounter technical issues, please report bugs on this page.
﻿    For general feedback or questions, feel free to send a message to Asakohee on the [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall]Stardew Valley Korean community[/url].

[b] ﻿Q: Why are the previously provided test assets no longer available?[/b]
[b] ﻿A:[/b] These assets are entirely unrelated to the actual functionality of this mod, which is why they have been [b]removed from this page[/b].[/size][size=3]
